title: Lungenkrebspatientenpfad – MiHUB (BPMN-Modell)
description: BPMN 2.0 models of the overarching lung-cancer patient pathway and nine sub-pathways (initial entry, screening, diagnostics, patient consultation, tumor board, molecular tumor board, treatment, palliative care [draft], aftercare), developed in the MiHUB project (TU Dresden / Forschungsgruppe Digital Health). A research, education and interoperability-reference artifact — not clinically validated and not for use in direct patient care (see DISCLAIMER.md).
